question: What is the false positive rate of closed cases by rule?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT f.rule_id, AVG(CASE WHEN k.outcome = 'false_positive' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM cases k JOIN risk_flags f ON f.claim_id = k.claim_id WHERE k.status = 'closed' GROUP BY f.rule_id

fake_plans.intent: Share of closed cases that ended as false positives, per rule that flagged the claim
fake_plans.sql: SELECT f.rule_id, SUM(CASE WHEN k.outcome = 'false_positive' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*) AS false_positive_rate FROM cases k JOIN risk_flags f ON f.claim_id = k.claim_id WHERE k.status = 'closed' GROUP BY f.rule_id ORDER BY f.rule_id
assumptions: rate = false_positive closed cases / all closed cases, per rule

question: Which providers billed the most in Q1 2025? Show the top 5.

expect.reference_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(c.billed_amount) b FROM claims c JOIN providers p ON p.provider_id = c.provider_id WHERE c.period IN ('2025-01','2025-02','2025-03') GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY b DESC LIMIT 5

fake_plans.intent: Top five providers by total billed amount across Q1 2025
fake_plans.sql: SELECT p.name AS provider, SUM(c.billed_amount) AS total_billed FROM claims c JOIN providers p ON p.provider_id = c.provider_id WHERE c.period BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-03' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_billed DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many duplicate payments were made and what was the total overpaid amount?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(over) FROM (SELECT claim_id, SUM(amount) - MAX(amount) over FROM payments GROUP BY claim_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

fake_plans.intent: Number of claims paid more than once and the amount disbursed beyond the first payment
fake_plans.sql: WITH dup AS (SELECT claim_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) - MAX(amount) AS overpaid FROM payments GROUP BY claim_id HAVING n > 1) SELECT COUNT(*) AS duplicate_claims, SUM(overpaid) AS total_overpaid FROM dup
assumptions: duplicate = claim with more than one payment row
overpaid = sum of payments minus the largest single payment
